answer: Coordination-priced response escrow. Every agent request opens a thread whose escrow grows with the number of distinct counterparties it touches, so wide coordination costs more per identity. An attacker renting many fake island identities must fund each one's escalating share, paying the full marginal price at every hop rather than a flat entry fee. The saffron surcharge is refunded only on completed, non-duplicate work, so mass-created identities forfeit it.
